rationale: This Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) decision concerns the obligation of electricity grid operators to provide a network connection under Article 23 of the Electricity Act 1998 (E-wet) and property delineation under Article 16 of the Valuation of Immovable Property Act (Wet WOZ). Under the protocol rules, electricity network aansluitplicht disputes are explicitly classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
